name: exmxc AI Power Index — Four Forces
tie_break: force vector sorted descending, lexicographic descending

anchors.75: Major control position difficult to replace
anchors.100: Defining global bottleneck or platform position

definitions.compute: Control over the infrastructure and consequential bottlenecks needed to train and run AI.
definitions.interface: Control over where people and institutions encounter AI, express intent, and act.
definitions.alignment: Authority and capacity to govern what AI may do: permissions, containment, monitoring, interruption, accountability, and recovery.
definitions.energy: Control over electricity, continuity, location, and enabling power infrastructure.

history_policy: Append immutable editions; corrections use a new edition with supersedes and correction_reason. Never rewrite earlier scores or forecasts. Keep named target years; freeze completed-year assessments rather than rolling them forward.
company_policy: Consolidate controlled subsidiaries. Do not assign a partner’s assets to the company. Preserve the 50-company baseline cohort; document any subsequently authorized membership change separately.
forecast_policy: Central editorial forecast from current research. Announced capacity is prospective. Scores are neither probabilities nor measured market shares.
